faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost and what is included in the free trial?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription plans: Plus at $20/month, Pro at $60/month, and Ultra at $120/month. Every plan begins with a 3-day free trial providing up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; your linked card is charged only after the trial concludes unless cancelled beforehand.

faq.q: Which languages does Ceyo support for research and interaction?
faq.a: Ceyo supports dozens of global languages including English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, German, and Mandarin. Agents can read documents, conduct browser research, and communicate across multiple languages seamlessly.

faq.q: How does the dedicated cloud computer protect my data?
faq.a: Every bot runs in its own secure, sandboxed cloud environment with persistent storage and dedicated compute. Your workflows, local files, and browsing sessions remain fully isolated from other users.

faq.q: Can I control my Ceyo agents through Telegram?
faq.a: Yes, you can manage individual agents via direct Telegram messages or invite multiple specialist bots into group chats so they can collaborate together on complex tasks.

faq.q: Can Ceyo make voice calls and handle phone inquiries?
faq.a: Yes, Ceyo features voice and video capabilities, including autonomous phone-call agents that can conduct outbound calls and receive customer inquiries based on your instructions.
